frame_rule: sample_rows_per_video(seed=None) over the validation manifest rows, native 320x240 JPEG
prompt_example:
These are 8 frames, in time order, sampled from one surveillance video.
Which one category best describes what happens in the video?
A. Abuse
B. Arrest
C. Arson
D. Assault
E. Burglary
F. Explosion
G. Fighting
H. Normal activity (no crime)
I. Road accident
J. Robbery
K. Shooting
L. Shoplifting
M. Stealing
N. Vandalism
Answer with the letter only.
